title: CatOS 2026.11.12
content:
CatOS is a Chinese Linux distribution based on Arch Linux and featuring a customised KDE Plasma desktop. Its main characteristics include out-of-the-box support for simplified Chinese input method, Calamares system installer, custom software repositories, and support for virtualization. It also provides a choice of Linux kernels, including the long-term supported variant, as well as mainline, Zen and hardened kernels. CatOS intends to be a user-friendly Linux distribution, especially for Chinese-speaking users.
